description: This file defines configuration classes and validation logic for grain types within the Orleans framework. It includes options for specifying grain classes and interfaces, as well as providers and validators to enforce correct configuration.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptions
classes.description: Holds collections of grain classes and interfaces.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeOptionsProvider
classes.description: Provides default configuration for GrainTypeOptions based on type manifests.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates that the grain type options are correctly configured, especially in silo environments.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Populates GrainTypeOptions with types derived from the TypeManifestOptions, filtering for appropriate grain classes and interfaces.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that grain interfaces and classes are properly configured, throwing exceptions if not in a silo context.
